game_start.intro: Tha an geama a' tòiseachadh. Suith thrumpa: {trump_suit} (cairt thrumpa: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Tha thu na Chluicheadair {player_id} ann an Whist Ghearmailteach.
{phase_info}
Tha thu a' giùlan {hand_size} cairtean.
Cluich cairt le '[play N]', far a bheil N na shiostam aice ann an do lamh (mar eisimpleir '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: GUS A 'GHAOIL: bidh an neach a bhuannaicheas gach cleas a' gabhail cairt aghaidh suas agus am fear a chailleas na ath chàrta bho deck. Cleasan air choisinn anns an ìre seo chan eil iad gan cunntadh airson buannachd.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Tha gach cleas a-nis air cunntadh gu buannachadh.

next_card.playing_phase: Chan eil cairt air a thabhann - thòisich an ìre cluich.
next_card.deck_empty: Tha an deic falamh - chan eil cairt air a thabhann.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Foirm gluasad neo-dhligheach. Cleachd '[play N]' gus an Nth cairt a tha nad làimh a chluich.
invalid_move.bad_position: Chan eil an suidheachadh cairt sin ann. Tha thu a' cumail {hand_size} chairtean.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Feumaidh tu an cois a leantainn agus cairt {lead_suit} a chluich.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Chan urrainnear an cairt sin a chluich.

trick.won: Bidh cluicheadair {winner_id} a 'buannachadh an cleas le {card}.
trick.won_learning: Cluicheadair {winner_id} a' buannachd an t-earrann le {card} agus a' gabhail a' chairt a tha fosgailte

phase.learning_complete: Tha an deic air a bhith sgìth. Tha am ìre ionnsachaidh seachad - tha gach cleas eile a 'cunntadh airson buannachadh.

draw.winner_received: Bhuannaich thu an cleas agus fhuair tu {card}.
draw.loser_received: Chaill thu an cleas agus tharraing {card} bhon deic.
draw.winner_preview: Is e an ath chairt a tha air a thabhann {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Earrannan a bhuail thusa gu ruige seo - Cluicheadair 0: {tricks0}, Cluicheadair 1: {tricks1}
turn.scores_playing: Earrannan a' cur às - Cluicheadair 0: {tricks0}, Cluicheadair 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Roinn: {phase} ({remaining_cards} cairtean a dh'fhàgail sa chlò)

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Chan eil cairtean ann an làimh.
hand.trump_indicator: (TRUMP) Tha mi a 'smaoineachadh gu bheil e coltach.

trick_view.empty: Chan eil cairtean a chluich fhathast an cleas seo.
trick_view.trump_indicator: (TRUMP) Tha mi a 'smaoineachadh gu bheil e coltach.

board_str.trump_indicator: (TRUMP) Tha mi a 'smaoineachadh gu bheil e coltach.
